risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including attacks on its systems and data. The report emphasizes the strategic importance of cybersecurity with a dedicated governance program led by the CISO and a specialized steering committee.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as a Financial Holding Company and must comply with the Dodd-Frank Act and federal, state, and local mandates related to public companies and banking institutions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market where numerous banks and financial institutions exist. The ability to introduce new competitive products and services in a timely manner is essential.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks, including lawsuits. The report indicates that the company may be involved in litigation with uncertain outcomes.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: As a local financial institution, the company depends heavily on customer and partner trust for deposits and liquidity sources. Any scandal or crisis could impair its operational capacity.

ai_positioning.summary: TMP does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report, indicating an absence of communication on this subject.
